review: The curve is upside down in the middle. Saw Mill is stage 3 but it is the hardest: all three recorded players die, and it throws four floating saws at jump height with no safe first saw to learn from. Ferry Lines hides its only saw at 80%, after the ferries, which reads as a gotcha. Then Spring Loaded at stage 6 has almost no risk; nobody dies on its long spike bed. I like Laser Gate: dotted beams telegraph the timing and deaths look earned. Gauntlet mixes every mechanic fairly. First Steps kills two of three players, which is harsh for a tutorial.
best: Laser Gate teaches its timing with clear telegraphed beams before it adds spikes and a saw.
worst: Saw Mill tests a saw swarm at stage 3 before it teaches one saw, and even the high-skill player dies.
